dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Thanks to the efforts of various big shots, we can finally do business freely once again."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Many of our friends who'd lost confidence have gained it again, and those who went bankrupt have hope of regaining their liquidity."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'd love to say more, but things are so busy..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Whatever the case may be, to anyone who reads this message, I wish you luck in the coming days!"
